Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. <!doctype html>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const size = 216;
const unit = 1 / 54;
const tilt = 0.145;
const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, Math.cos(tilt), -Math.sin(tilt));
const forward = new THREE.Vector3(0, Math.sin(tilt), Math.cos(tilt));
const center = new THREE.Vector3(0, 118 * unit, 0);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
  preserveDrawingBuffer: true,
  antialias: true
});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(size, size);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.NoToneMapping;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf4f6f4);
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2, 2, 2, -2, 0.1, 180);
ref.position.copy(center).addScaledVector(forward, 13);
ref.lookAt(center);

function point(x, y, depth) {
  return center.clone()
    .add(new THREE.Vector3((x - 108) * unit, 0, 0))
    .addScaledVector(up, (108 - y) * unit)
    .addScaledVector(forward, depth);
}

function group(parent, name, origin = null) {
  const part = new THREE.Group();
  part.name = name;
  if (origin) {
    part.position.copy(origin);
    if (parent.userData.origin) part.position.sub(parent.userData.origin);
    part.userData.origin = origin;
  }
  parent.add(part);
  return part;
}

function light(color, intensity, x, y, z) {

  lamp.position.set(x, y, z);
  scene.add(lamp);
}
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffaef, 0xe2cbb0, 1.72));

const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(140, 140),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      nearColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xd1d2d0) },
      farColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xf5f7f5) }
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec3 floorPosition;
      void main() {
        vec4 world = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
        floorPosition = world.xyz;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * world;
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform vec3 nearColor;
      uniform vec3 farColor;
      varying vec3 floorPosition;
      float hash(vec2 p) {
        return fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(p, vec2(0.06711056, 0.00583715))));
      }
      float oval(vec2 p, vec2 center, vec2 extent) {
        vec2 q = (p - center) / extent;
        return exp(-dot(q, q));
      }
      void main() {
        vec2 p = floorPosition.xz;
        float mist = smoothstep(2.25, 10.9, -p.y);
        vec3 color = mix(nearColor, farColor, mist);
        float shadow = 0.085 * oval(p, vec2(1.20, -1.17), vec2(1.67, 2.90));
        shadow += 0.085 * oval(p, vec2(0.34, -0.20), vec2(0.34, 0.43));
        shadow += 0.096 * oval(p, vec2(1.23, 0.04), vec2(0.42, 0.47));
        float clouds = sin(p.x * 1.8 + p.y * 0.83)
          * sin(p.y * 1.09 - p.x * 1.29);
        color *= 1.0 - shadow + 0.010 * clouds;
        color += (hash(gl_FragCoord.xy) - 0.5) * 0.018;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
        #include <colorspace_fragment>
      }
    `
  })
);

const pigment = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({

pigment.onBeforeCompile = shader => {
  shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader
    .replace('#include <common>', '#include <common>\nvarying vec3 pilePosition;')
    .replace('#include <begin_vertex>', '#include <begin_vertex>\npilePosition = position;');
  shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader
    .replace('#include <common>', `
      #include <common>
      varying vec3 pilePosition;
      float pileHash(vec3 p) {
        p = fract(p * 0.3183099 + vec3(0.13, 0.31, 0.71));
        p *= 17.0;
        return fract(p.x * p.y * p.z * (p.x + p.y + p.z));
      }
      float pileNoise(vec3 p) {
        vec3 i = floor(p);
        vec3 f = fract(p);
        f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
        return mix(
          mix(mix(pileHash(i), pileHash(i + vec3(1,0,0)), f.x),
              mix(pileHash(i + vec3(0,1,0)), pileHash(i + vec3(1,1,0)), f.x), f.y),
          mix(mix(pileHash(i + vec3(0,0,1)), pileHash(i + vec3(1,0,1)), f.x),
              mix(pileHash(i + vec3(0,1,1)), pileHash(i + vec3(1,1,1)), f.x), f.y),
          f.z);
      }
    `).replace('#include <color_fragment>', `
      #include <color_fragment>
      vec3 nap = pilePosition * vec3(72.0, 47.0, 72.0);
      float mottle = pileNoise(pilePosition * 15.0) - 0.5;
      float grain = pileNoise(nap) - 0.5;
      float fine = pileNoise(nap * 2.31 + 9.0) - 0.5;
      diffuseColor.rgb *= 1.0 + 0.105 * mottle + 0.22 * grain + 0.115 * fine;
    `);
};

const fiberMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({

const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

function ease(a, b, value) {
  const t = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((value - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
}

function sampleRows(rows, fraction) {
  const u = fraction * (rows.length - 1);
  const i = Math.min(rows.length - 2, Math.floor(u));
  const t = u - i;
  const before = rows[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
  const start = rows[i];
  const end = rows[i + 1];
  const after = rows[Math.min(rows.length - 1, i + 2)];
  return start.map((v, k) => {
    const e = end[k];
    const m0 = (e - before[k]) * 0.5;
    const m1 = (after[k] - v) * 0.5;
    return v + t * (m0 + t * (3 * (e - v) - 2 * m0 - m1 +
      t * (2 * (v - e) + m0 + m1)));
  });
}

function ringMesh(parent, name, length, around, sample, material, flip = false) {
  const positions = [];
  const colors = [];
  const indices = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < length; r++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < around; i++) {
      const { p, c } = sample(r / (length - 1), i / around);
      positions.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
    }
  }
  for (let r = 0; r < length - 1; r++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < around; i++) {
      const a = r * around + i;
      const b = r * around + (i + 1) % around;
      const c = a + around;
      const d = b + around;
      if (flip) indices.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
      else indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
    }
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

let seed = 93716;
function random() {
  seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0;
  return seed / 4294967296;
}

function addPile(mesh, count, length, skip = () => false) {
  const source = mesh.geometry;
  const positions = source.attributes.position;
  const normals = source.attributes.normal;
  const colors = source.attributes.color;
  const index = source.index.array;
  const areas = [];
  const triangles = [];
  const a = new THREE.Vector3();
  const b = new THREE.Vector3();
  const c = new THREE.Vector3();
  const side = new THREE.Vector3();
  const other = new THREE.Vector3();
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < index.length; i += 3) {
    a.fromBufferAttribute(positions, index[i]);
    b.fromBufferAttribute(positions, index[i + 1]);
    c.fromBufferAttribute(positions, index[i + 2]);
    if (skip(a, b, c)) continue;
    const area = side.subVectors(b, a).cross(other.subVectors(c, a)).length();
    if (area < 1e-8) continue;
    total += area;
    areas.push(total);
    triangles.push(i);
  }
  const vertices = [];
  const vertexNormals = [];
  const vertexColors = [];
  const root = new THREE.Vector3();
  const normal = new THREE.Vector3();
  const along = new THREE.Vector3();
  const tip = new THREE.Vector3();
  for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
    const choice = random() * total;
    let lo = 0;
    let hi = areas.length - 1;
    while (lo < hi) {
      const middle = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
      if (choice > areas[middle]) lo = middle + 1;
      else hi = middle;
    }
    const start = triangles[lo];
    const ia = index[start];
    const ib = index[start + 1];
    const ic = index[start + 2];
    const u = Math.sqrt(random());
    const v = random() * u;
    const wa = 1 - u;
    const wb = u - v;
    root.fromBufferAttribute(positions, ia).multiplyScalar(wa)
      .addScaledVector(a.fromBufferAttribute(positions, ib), wb)
      .addScaledVector(b.fromBufferAttribute(positions, ic), v);
    normal.fromBufferAttribute(normals, ia).multiplyScalar(wa)
      .addScaledVector(a.fromBufferAttribute(normals, ib), wb)
      .addScaledVector(b.fromBufferAttribute(normals, ic), v).normalize();
    root.addScaledVector(normal, -0.0013);
    along.set((random() - 0.5) * 0.75, -1, (random() - 0.5) * 0.8);
    along.addScaledVector(normal, -along.dot(normal)).normalize();
    side.crossVectors(normal, along).normalize().multiplyScalar(0.0010 + random() * 0.0011);
    const height = length * (0.37 + random() * 0.85);
    tip.copy(root).addScaledVector(normal, height * 0.66).addScaledVector(along, height);
    a.copy(root).add(side);
    b.copy(root).sub(side);
    const shade = 0.87 + random() * 0.34;
    for (const p of [a, b, tip]) {
      vertices.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      vertexNormals.push(normal.x, normal.y, normal.z);
      vertexColors.push(colors.getX(ia) * shade, colors.getY(ia) * shade, colors.getZ(ia) * shade);
    }
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertexNormals, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertexColors, 3));
  const fibers = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, fiberMaterial);
  fibers.name = 'short downy fibers';
  mesh.add(fibers);
}

function loft(parent, name, rows, tint, length = 61, around = 64, material = pigment) {
  return ringMesh(parent, name, length, around, (fraction, turn) => {
    const [x, y, depth, width, thickness] = sampleRows(rows, fraction);
    const angle = turn * TAU;
    const px = x + Math.cos(angle) * Math.max(0.015, width);
    const z = depth + Math.sin(angle) * Math.max(0.015, thickness) * unit;
    return {
      p: point(px, y, z).sub(parent.userData.origin),
      c: tint(px, y, angle, fraction)
    };
  }, material);
}

function bodyTint(x, y, angle) {
  const front = Math.sin(angle);
  const color = gold.clone().lerp(honey, 1 - ease(58, 170, y));
  const underChin = Math.exp(-((x - 114) / 23) ** 2 - ((y - 76) / 13) ** 2);
  const underArm = Math.exp(-((x - 150) / 9) ** 2 - ((y - 119) / 33) ** 2);
  color.lerp(ochre, Math.max(0, front) * (0.17 * underChin + 0.27 * underArm));
  if (y >= 108.7 && y <= 171.8 && front > 0) {
    let i = 1;
    while (bellyProfile[i][0] < y) i++;
    const [y0, l0, r0] = bellyProfile[i - 1];
    const [y1, l1, r1] = bellyProfile[i];
    const blend = (y - y0) / (y1 - y0);
    const left = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(l0, l1, blend);
    const right = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(r0, r1, blend);
    const edge = 0.85 + 0.25 * Math.sin(y * 1.1);
    const mask = ease(left - edge, left + edge, x)
      * (1 - ease(right - edge, right + edge, x))
      * ease(0.04, 0.29, front)
      * ease(108.7, 110.8, y) * (1 - ease(169.5, 171.8, y));
    const cream = biscuit.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color(0xd1b28e), 0.43 * (1 - ease(111, 175, y)));
    color.lerp(cream, mask * 0.98);
  }
  return color;
}

function makeHand(parent, name, anchor, palm, fingers) {
  const hand = group(parent, name, anchor);
  loft(hand, 'wrist and palm', palm, handTint, 27, 40, palmMaterial);
  for (const [name, path] of fingers) {
    const [x, y, z] = path[0];
    const digit = group(hand, name, point(x, y, z));
    loft(digit, 'tapered finger', path, handTint, 27, 20, palmMaterial);
  }
}

const head = group(figure, 'tilted head', point(122, 46, 0.88));
head.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), -radians)
  .multiply(new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
    new THREE.Euler(-0.08, -0.13, -0.235, 'ZXY')
  ));
const headRx = 29.4;
const headRy = 34.7;
const headRz = 25.8;
const mouthCenter = new THREE.Vector2(0, -7.2);

function headX(x, y) {
  return x * (1 - 0.11 * Math.max(0, -y / headRy)) + 0.036 * y;
}
function faceDepth(x, y) {
  const r2 = (x / headRx) ** 2 + (y / headRy) ** 2;
  const cheek = Math.exp(-((Math.abs(x) - 15.6) / 7.3) ** 2 - ((y + 4) / 13) ** 2);
  const muzzle = Math.exp(-(x / 10) ** 2 - ((y - 10.3) / 5.6) ** 2);
  const brow = Math.exp(-((Math.abs(x) - 14) / 8) ** 2 - ((y - 20) / 5) ** 2);
  return headRz * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - r2))
    + (0.85 * cheek + 1.28 * muzzle + 0.58 * brow) * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - r2));
}
function facePoint(x, y, z = faceDepth(x, y)) {
  return new THREE.Vector3(headX(x, y) * unit, y * unit, z * unit);
}

const outline = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
  [-1,10.7], [6.6,10.25], [12.7,9.0], [15.8,6.2],
  [15.7,1.0], [13.7,-5.5], [10.5,-13.1], [6.8,-21.8],
  [1.15,-26.4], [-4.2,-27.1], [-9.2,-23.9], [-12.35,-17.9],
  [-14.0,-10.0], [-15.5,-2.4], [-15.8,4.8], [-12.6,8.5], [-6.9,10.2]
].map(([x, y]) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, 0)), true, 'centripetal');

function rayRim(x, y) {
  const ox = mouthCenter.x / headRx;
  const oy = mouthCenter.y / headRy;
  const dx = (x - mouthCenter.x) / headRx;
  const dy = (y - mouthCenter.y) / headRy;
  const a = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const b = ox * dx + oy * dy;
  const c = ox * ox + oy * oy - 1;
  const t = (-b + Math.sqrt(b * b - a * c)) / a;
  return [mouthCenter.x + t * dx, mouthCenter.y + t * dy];
}

const headSkin = ringMesh(head, 'continuous face and skull', 99, 132, (fraction, turn) => {
  const lip = outline.getPoint(turn);
  const [rimX, rimY] = rayRim(lip.x, lip.y);
  let x, y, z;
  const rimAt = 0.59;
  if (fraction <= rimAt) {
    const walk = Math.sin((fraction / rimAt) * Math.PI / 2);
    x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(lip.x, rimX, walk);
    y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(lip.y, rimY, walk);
    z = faceDepth(x, y) + 0.9 * Math.exp(-walk * 17) * (1 - walk);
  } else {
    const polar = (fraction - rimAt) / (1 - rimAt) * (Math.PI * 0.5 - 0.001);
    x = rimX * Math.cos(polar);
    y = rimY * Math.cos(polar);
    z = -headRz * Math.sin(polar);
  }
  const color = honey.clone().lerp(paleGold, 0.69 * ease(-13, 31, y));
  color.lerp(gold, 0.27 * (1 - ease(-28, 6, y)));
  if (fraction <= rimAt) {
    const aroundLip = Math.exp(-fraction * 37);
    const atJaw = 1 - ease(-18, 3, y);
    color.lerp(ochre, aroundLip * (0.41 - 0.22 * atJaw));
    color.lerp(new THREE.Color(0xd3aa5b), aroundLip * atJaw * 0.54);
  }
  return { p: facePoint(x, y, z), c: color };
}, pigment);
addPile(headSkin, 5200, 0.014, (a, b, c) => {
  const x = (a.x + b.x + c.x) / (3 * unit);
  const y = (a.y + b.y + c.y) / (3 * unit);
  const z = (a.z + b.z + c.z) / (3 * unit);
  return z > 13 && ((Math.abs(x) < 18 && y < 13) || (Math.abs(x) > 7 && y > 17));
});

const eyes = group(head, 'closed eyes');
const lidBlack = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x21160d, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const lidGold = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xaf8028, roughness: 0.89, side: THREE.DoubleSide
});
function eyelid(name, controls, thickness) {
  const eye = group(eyes, name);
  const line = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(controls.map(([x, y]) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, 0)));
  const middle = line.getPoint(0.5);
  eye.position.copy(facePoint(middle.x, middle.y));
  function trace(label, mat, width, offset, height) {
    const positions = [];
    const indices = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 42; i++) {
      const t = i / 42;
      const p = line.getPoint(t);
      const d = line.getTangent(t);
      const w = width * (0.11 + 0.89 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t) ** 0.68);
      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        const x = p.x - d.y * w * side;
        const y = p.y + d.x * w * side + offset;
        const v = facePoint(x, y, faceDepth(x, y) + height).sub(eye.position);
        positions.push(v.x, v.y, v.z);
      }
      const a = 2 * i;
      if (i < 42) indices.push(a, a + 2, a + 1, a + 1, a + 2, a + 3);
    }
    const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
    geometry.setIndex(indices);
    geometry.computeVertexNormals();
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, mat);
    mesh.name = label;
    eye.add(mesh);
  }
  trace('soft rim of eyelid', lidGold, thickness * 1.33, -0.31, 0.34);
  trace('dark crescent', lidBlack, thickness, 0, 0.57);
}
eyelid('image-left eyelid', [[-23.6,16.0],[-21.6,19.7],[-18.1,21.6],[-14.5,21.2],[-11.6,19.1]], 0.76);
eyelid('image-right eyelid', [[7.0,19.5],[10.6,22.1],[14.7,22.45],[18.6,20.6],[22.6,16.5]], 1.03);

const mouth = group(head, 'open laughing mouth');
mouth.position.copy(facePoint(mouthCenter.x, mouthCenter.y));
const cavityDark = new THREE.Color(0x080504);
const cavityRim = new THREE.Color(0x503020);
const cavityLower = new THREE.Color(0x70472e);
ringMesh(mouth, 'recessed mouth cavity', 27, 132, (fraction, turn) => {
  const lip = outline.getPoint(turn);
  const radial = 1 - fraction * 0.9995;
  const x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(mouthCenter.x, lip.x, radial);
  const y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(mouthCenter.y, lip.y, radial);
  const lipZ = faceDepth(lip.x, lip.y) + 0.9;
  const depth = lipZ - 0.04 - (lipZ - 5.1) * (fraction ** 0.58);
  const rim = cavityRim.clone().lerp(cavityLower, 1 - ease(-22, -9, lip.y));
  const c = rim.lerp(cavityDark, ease(0.005, 0.21, fraction));
  return { p: facePoint(x, y, depth).sub(mouth.position), c };
}, cavityMaterial, true);

function mouthOval(parent, name, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, color, rotation) {
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 20),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness: 0.88 })
  );
  mesh.name = name;
  mesh.position.copy(facePoint(x, y, z)).sub(mouth.position);
  mesh.scale.set(sx * unit, sy * unit, sz * unit);
  mesh.rotation.z = rotation;
  parent.add(mesh);
}
const tongue = group(mouth, 'low curved tongue');
mouthOval(tongue, 'tongue body', -1.3, -21.1, 11.55, 8.35, 3.05, 2.25, 0x49251f, 0.15);

const upperTeeth = group(mouth, 'upper teeth');
const lowerTeeth = group(mouth, 'lower teeth');
const enamel = [
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf8e9ce, roughness: 0.58, emissive: 0x3d3120, emissiveIntensity: 0.17 }),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe8d7b4, roughness: 0.62, emissive: 0x3d3120, emissiveIntensity: 0.12 }),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xfdf1db, roughness: 0.56, emissive: 0x3d3120, emissiveIntensity: 0.18 })
];
function tooth(parent, name, x, y, z, w, h, angle, tone, upper) {
  const geometry = new RoundedBoxGeometry(w * unit, h * unit, (1.65 + 0.11 * h) * unit, 3, 0.53 * unit);
  const vertices = geometry.attributes.position;
  for (let i = 0; i < vertices.count; i++) {
    const end = vertices.getY(i) / (h * unit);
    const taper = 0.92 + (upper ? end : -end) * 0.23;
    vertices.setX(i, vertices.getX(i) * taper);
  }
  vertices.computeBoundingSphere;
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, enamel[tone]);
  mesh.name = name;
  mesh.position.copy(facePoint(x, y, z)).sub(mouth.position);
  mesh.rotation.set(upper ? -0.12 : 0.11, -0.012 * x, angle);
  parent.add(mesh);
}
